scope: Direct model visual inspection of original-colour offline renders, generated from actual post-runtime Babylon CPU skins and original 4K atlas; not browser GPU screenshots.
findings: No gross elongated shafts or changing muscle core thickness in inspected frontal/lateral/oblique attack, brace, gait, death and distant orbit-to-run views.
Final collapse has asymmetrically relaxed paws, cheek and torso support, full tail in top/support views; no hidden floor penetration in final evaluated source proof.
Distant observation-to-run transition uses reachable fixed-length legs and releases unreachable earlier foot anchors. This does not certify every transient foot is stationary.
Existing hard/angular collar folds remain around bending joints. Rigid muscle cores and narrow transition bands are separate checks.
Source image concepts were generated before collapse authoring. Original R8 bone lengths and source weights remain authoritative.
limits: Real-device FPS, heat, GPU timings, touch feel and visible player knockdown animation were not measured.
